content.detail-body:
Domain defines concepts and relations. Substance describes an instance. Style maps that meaning to a visual representation.

A useful precedent for separating design intent from appearance. Its optimization does not prove universal aesthetic quality.

https://github.com/penrose/penrose
content.comparison-notes: Compare what each approach owns: semantic structure, perceptual evaluation, or geometric constraints. They solve different parts of the design problem.
